beyondBody: On stage I'm a Marathi stand-up comic: a stand-up set on ZEE5, appearances on Zee Marathi's Chala Hawa Yeu Dya, plus short films, podcasts and an audiobook.
contactBody:
Whether it's a technology discussion, an engineering challenge, a collaboration, or simply exchanging ideas, I'm always open to meaningful conversations.

Good ideas often start with a simple conversation.

Let's connect.
exploringBody:
Technology never stands still, and neither should we.

I'm currently exploring Generative AI, LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, Agentic AI, modern system architecture, and engineering leadership.

I enjoy experimenting with emerging technologies and understanding how they can solve real-world problems.
exploringNote: The goal isn't to chase every new technology. It's to understand what is genuinely useful.
expertiseIntro:
Every technology is a tool. Knowing when and how to use it makes the difference.

Here's what I work with to design, develop, and deliver modern web applications.
heroLine:
I'm a software engineer with 12+ years of experience building modern web applications, solving engineering challenges, and turning complex ideas into practical solutions.

My expertise spans frontend engineering, modern web architecture, and backend integrations. I'm also exploring the possibilities of Generative AI and intelligent applications.
heroTopLeft: Building better software. Learning continuously. Sharing the journey.
intro:
I believe good software engineering is about more than writing code. It's about understanding problems, making thoughtful decisions, and building solutions that work for people.

Over the years, I've worked across frontend engineering, backend integrations, and modern web technologies. My journey has taught me the importance of clean architecture, collaboration, continuous improvement, and keeping things simple without compromising quality.

I'm particularly interested in frontend architecture, engineering best practices, and the evolving world of Generative AI.

Outside the code editor, I'm a curious learner, an occasional writer, and someone who enjoys exploring ideas from different perspectives.

There's always something new to build, learn, or question.
notesBody:
Some things are best learned by building. Others by breaking things, asking questions, and figuring out why they didn't work.

This is where I share practical insights, technical explorations, lessons from real-world engineering, and things worth understanding beyond the documentation.

No unnecessary complexity. Just ideas, experiments, and learnings worth sharing.
notesTitle: Notes from the world of code
